realm.name: Demo
realm.description: A worked example: the internal handbook of a fictional company, with procedures for purchasing, travel, site access and incidents.

prompts.name: Grounded handbook QA
prompts.description: Answers from the given context only, citing a section for every statement.

generation_presets.name: Single-section question
generation_presets.description: One question answerable from a single excerpt, for checking direct retrieval.

questions.question: Who approves a purchase of 12,000 EUR?
questions.ground_truth: The finance director. Orders between 5,000 and 50,000 EUR fall into band C, which the finance director approves.

questions.question: Is it allowed to split one large order into smaller ones to stay under an approval threshold?
questions.ground_truth: No. Splitting a purchase to stay inside a lower band is a policy violation and is reported under the incident procedure.

questions.question: What is the daily allowance for a trip outside Europe, and what happens on the day of departure?
questions.ground_truth: 85 EUR per full day. Departure and return days are paid at half that rate.

questions.question: How long do I have to submit an expense claim after a trip?
questions.ground_truth: 30 calendar days after returning. A claim submitted after 60 days is paid only with the finance director's approval, and the reason for the delay is recorded.

questions.question: What should I do if I lose my badge, and how quickly is it deactivated?
questions.ground_truth: Report it to the site manager the same day. The lost badge is deactivated within one hour of the report and a replacement is issued the next working day.

questions.question: How many visitors may one employee escort at a time in the assembly area?
questions.ground_truth: Six. An escorted visitor group may not exceed six people per escort in class 2 and class 3 areas.

questions.question: A contractor will be on site for two weeks and needs access to the calibration room. What is required before they can start?
questions.ground_truth: A temporary badge rather than daily visitor badges, since the stay exceeds five consecutive days. Before it is issued the contractor provides proof of liability insurance and completes the site safety briefing. Calibration room access is class 3, which the head of engineering approves, and the work is supervised by a Northwind employee.

questions.question: A delivery arrives with visible damage to the outer packaging. What does the receiving clerk do?
questions.ground_truth: Accept it, note the damage on the carrier's paperwork, and photograph it before opening the packaging.

questions.question: Which received items get a printed asset tag?
questions.ground_truth: Items costing 1,000 EUR or more, after they pass inspection and are entered into the asset register.

questions.question: A cycle count on a 400 EUR part shows three units fewer than the record, out of 20 recorded. What happens next?
questions.ground_truth: The difference exceeds both one unit and two percent, so it is investigated before any adjustment. The investigation reviews the movement log since the previous count and reports to the head of engineering within five working days. High-value parts above 250 EUR per unit are cycle counted quarterly.

questions.question: Something almost went wrong but nobody was hurt. Do I still report it, and by when?
questions.ground_truth: Yes. An event that could plausibly have caused harm is an incident. It is reported by the end of the working day on which it was noticed.
relevant_paths: Reporting an incident/What counts as an incident

questions.question: I deleted a file from the shared drive three weeks ago. Can I get it back?
questions.ground_truth: Not by yourself, because the recycle area holds deletions for 14 days. Beyond that it is a request to the systems team stating the full path, the approximate deletion date and the reason, answered within two working days.
relevant_paths: Backups and file storage/Recovering a file

questions.question: When does an approved change to a procedure start applying?
questions.ground_truth: On a stated effective date, never immediately on approval. The minimum notice is five working days, extended to twenty working days where the change requires training.
relevant_paths: Changing an approved procedure/Adoption and effective date

questions.question: What is the weather forecast for tomorrow?
questions.ground_truth: The handbook does not cover this. The assistant should decline rather than answer.

questions.question: What is the average salary of a robotics engineer in Germany this year?
questions.ground_truth: The handbook does not cover this. The assistant should decline rather than answer.
